root_cause.text: The sched_ext subsystem's direct dispatch state (p->scx.ddsp_dsq_id) was only cleared in dispatch_enqueue(), leaving stale state on code paths that consume or cancel a direct dispatch verdict without calling that function, leading to a spurious warning on subsequent wakeups.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states, "The root cause is that ddsp_dsq_id was only cleared in dispatch_enqueue(), which is not reached in all paths that consume or cancel a direct dispatch verdict." The patch adds explicit clearing of the direct dispatch state in direct_dispatch(), process_ddsp_deferred_locals(), do_enqueue_task(), dequeue_task_scx(), and scx_disable_task().
